narr: A slow moving storm system over the central United States produced a round of thunderstorms with flooding rains over southeast Arkansas. Significant flooding occurred in portions of the region.
ev: About 15 streets and roads in Dermott, as well as several in Lake Village, were closed due to flooding. Some businesses in Dermott were flooded, and residents resorted to using sandbags to keep out floodwaters from homes and businesses.
Five roads in Eudora were closed due to flooding.
Several streets around Lake Village were flooded.
